milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the tower's dark_oak_leaves crown (centered at spawn-relative 8,9,8) and face toward it, confirming they can visually observe the leaves. max_distance=16 allows seeing it from a reasonable distance, facing_tolerance=60 ensures they're looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The powered_rail is at spawn-relative (-6, 0, 0). The player must navigate near it and face toward it to confirm visual observation. max_distance=16 is generous for spotting a rail on the ground, facing_tolerance=60 ensures they're looking in the right direction.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a spruce_button results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. No spruce_button exists in the scene initially, so having one confirms successful crafting. Recipe: 1 spruce_plank → 1 spruce_button in 2x2 grid.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because lighting the tower requires placing a redstone_torch adjacent to the redstone_lamps on the tower. The lamps are at y=5 around position (8,5,8). A generous box (6-10, 4-7, 6-10) encompasses all possible torch placement positions next to the 4 lamps. Detecting at least 1 placed redstone_torch confirms the player powered the lamps.
